```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(here)

knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
options(box.path = here())

box::use(
  r / load
)
box::reload(load)

library(MASS)
library(tidyverse)
library(marginaleffects)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggeffects)
library(ggpubr)

theme_set(theme_minimal())

channels <- load$channels()
videos <- load$videos(filtered = TRUE)
sentences <- load$sentences(filtered = TRUE)
popbert <- load$popbert(filtered = TRUE)

df_sents <- sentences |>
  left_join(popbert, by = "sentence_id") |>
  group_by(video_id) |>
  summarize(
    elite = mean(elite),
    pplcentr = mean(pplcentr)
  )

df <- channels |>
  left_join(videos, by = "channel_id") |>
  left_join(df_sents, by = "video_id") |>
  mutate(
    channel = factor(channel)
  )
```

```{r}
z_transform <- function(x) as.vector(scale(x))

df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    year = video_uploadtime |> lubridate::year() |> as_factor(),
    channel = channel |> as_factor()
  ) %>%
  group_by(channel) %>%
  mutate(
    elite = z_transform(elite),
    pplcentr = z_transform(pplcentr)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

df_likes <- df |>
  filter(channel != "FDP") |>
  mutate(channel = channel |> as_factor() |> fct_drop())
```

# NB Regression on Video Likes

```{r}
elite_form <- formula(
  video_likes ~ channel + elite + channel:elite + year + video_duration
)

elite_model <- glm.nb(elite_form, data = df_likes)
summary(elite_model)
```

```{r}
pplcentr_form <- formula(
  video_likes ~ channel + pplcentr + channel:pplcentr + year + video_duration
)

pplcentr_model <- glm.nb(pplcentr_form, data = df_likes)
summary(pplcentr_model)
```

```{r}
elite_plot <- marginaleffects::plot_predictions(
    elite_model,
    condition = list("channel", "elite" = "threenum")
  ) +
  coord_flip() +
  theme_ggeffects(base_family = "serif")

pplcentr_plot <- marginaleffects::plot_predictions(
    pplcentr_model,
    condition = list("channel", "pplcentr" = "threenum")
  ) +
  coord_flip() +
  theme_ggeffects(base_family = "serif")

ggarrange(elite_plot, pplcentr_plot, ncol = 1)
```

```{r}
ggsave(here("reports", "figures", "nb_regression_like_count.svg"), width = 7, height = 5)
```

```{r}
elite_plot <- marginaleffects::plot_slopes(
    elite_model,
    variables = "elite",
    condition = list("channel", "elite" = "threenum")
  ) +
  coord_flip() +
  theme_ggeffects(base_family = "serif")

pplcentr_plot <- marginaleffects::plot_slopes(
    pplcentr_model,
    variables = "pplcentr",
    condition = list("channel", "pplcentr" = "threenum")
  ) +
  coord_flip() +
  theme_ggeffects(base_family = "serif")

ggarrange(elite_plot, pplcentr_plot, ncol = 1)

# OLS rechnen, wobei die AV vorher in Ränge übersetzt ist. Könnte den Einfluss von Ausreißern minimieren. (Wollen wir das, though?)

```


# NB Regression on Video Views

```{r}
elite_form <- formula(
  video_views ~ channel + elite + channel:elite + year + video_duration
)

elite_model <- glm.nb(elite_form, data = df)
summary(elite_model)
```

```{r}
pplcentr_form <- formula(
  video_views ~ channel + pplcentr + channel:pplcentr + year + video_duration
)

pplcentr_model <- glm.nb(pplcentr_form, data = df)
summary(pplcentr_model)
```

```{r}
elite_plot <- sjPlot::plot_model(
  elite_model,
  type = "eff",
  terms = c("channel", "elite [-1,0,1]")
) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Marginal Effects of Anti-Elitism",
    x = "Channel",
    y = "Number of Views",
    color = "Anti-Elitism\n(standardized)"
  ) +
  theme_ggeffects(base_family = "serif")

pplcentr_plot <- sjPlot::plot_model(
  pplcentr_model,
  type = "eff",
  terms = c("channel", "pplcentr [-1,0,1]")
) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Marginal Effects of People-Centrism",
    x = "Channel",
    y = "Number of Views",
    color = "People-Centrism\n(standardized)"
  ) +
  theme_ggeffects(base_family = "serif")

ggarrange(elite_plot, pplcentr_plot, ncol = 1)
```

```{r}
ggsave(here("reports", "figures", "nb_regression_view_count.svg"), width = 7, height = 5)
```
